sloka: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे ऽस्मिन् सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे ।त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी ।। ५.३९.४५।।।।
transliteration: nihate rākṣasendre 'smin saputrāmātyabāndhave ।tvaṁ sameṣyasi rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī ।। 5.39.45।।।।

translations.english: "When Ravana is slain, with his sons, ministers and kith and kin, you will reunite with Rama as Rohini unites with the Moon.
